article.story: NEW YORK -- — Dejour Reaves had 19 points to help Fordham defeat New Haven 65-47 on Monday. Reaves went 9 of 13 from the field for the Rams (9-4). Rikus Schulte scored nine points and added 13 rebounds and four steals. Jack Whitbourn finished 3 of 5 from the floor and scored eight. Jabri Fitzpatrick led the way for the Chargers (5-7) with 10 points and Andre Pasha scored eight. Fordham took the lead with 1:46 left in the first half and did not trail again. Reaves led the team with 10 points for a 29-23 advantage at the break. Fordham used a 9-0 run in the second half to make it 45-30. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
